votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager's appointment of Adam R. Burney to the Land Use Director position.
votes.quote: mr. toale moved to ratify the town manager's appointment of adam r. burney to the land use director position.

votes.motion: Close the hearing on Alcoholic Beverages License #063600031 at 7:50PM.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to close the hearing at 7:50pm. mr. toale seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Issue a warning to JK Waterfront, Inc., d/b/a "On the Rocks" and ask the license holder to provide training to the employees, then report back to the Board of Selectmen.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved that the board of selectmen issue a warning to jk waterfront, inc., d/b/a "on the rocks" and ask that the license holder provide training to the employees

votes.motion: Authorize the Town Manager's request to send a letter to all license holders reminding them of the local regulations.
votes.quote: mr. toale moved to authorize the town manager's request. ms. luck seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Appoint Thomas Bertram to the Conservation Commission.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to appoint thomas bertram to the conservation commission. ms. luck seconded.

votes.motion: Appoint Jeffrey Bajko and Steven Walker to the Public Access Cable Committee.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to appoint jeffrey bajko and steven walker to the public access cable committee. ms. luck seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the change of hours for KJ Waterfront d/b/a Embers Pizzeria, 84 Lakefront Avenue, to 8AM for Sunday September 14, 2014 only.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to approve the change of hours for kj waterfront d/b/a embers pizzeria, 84 lakefront avenue to 8am for sunday september 14, 2014.
mr. toale moved to adjourn the meeting. mr. ebersole seconded. on vote, motion carried 4 in favor, 0 opposed.
